depiction_rules.notes: Provisional D044 supporting-character contract based only on his role as Krishna’s elder brother in verse 44-3 and 44-6; not an approved character master.

visual_bible.age: Very young child, only slightly older/larger than infant Krishna in these naming scenes; exact numerical age is not stated in the canonical verses. Keep an infant/toddler-scale body and never depict him as school-age.
visual_bible.face: gentle, distinct child face; do not duplicate Krishna’s features exactly
visual_bible.skin: natural warm light-brown mural pigment; avoid assigning divine blue to Balarama in this chapter
visual_bible.build: believable child proportions, slightly larger than the infant
visual_bible.clothing: plain muted cream or pale cloth suitable for a young child
visual_bible.continuity_markers: One distinct very young child with natural warm light-brown mural pigment, simple dark child hair and plain pale cloth; only slightly older/larger than the infant, with believable young-child proportions and ordinary two-arm anatomy. No precise age gap is established.

never: no crown unless a verse requires it
do not imply that this is an approved master
